goal: Select and freeze the smallest production-earned implementation contract for durable Bora PURSUE/WATCH/REJECT persistence after the five-role Manual Discovery dogfood batch. This governance branch may author the exact implementation contract only; it must not mutate runtime, schemas, Sheets, application history, Match Truth, identity, package logic, Gold sources, or submission policy.
acceptance_conditions: The exact implementation candidate is named CAREER_OS_PURSUIT_DECISION_PERSISTENCE_V1 and is grounded in the locked Personal V1 step 6 plus the five-role dogfood evidence.

The implementation contract requires exact canonical Job_ID membership before any human decision can be persisted; discovery-platform IDs, titles, URLs, screenshots, or company+role text alone cannot create a decision subject.
The implementation contract preserves system recommendation and Bora decision as separate co-existing truths.
The implementation contract preserves append-only decision history and explicit supersession so the two temporary PURSUE test events can coexist with the final REJECT decisions.
The implementation contract defines stale-intent invalidation/reconfirmation semantics bound to current opportunity/analysis context.
The implementation contract reuses the existing JOBS and LOG Sheets V1 surfaces and introduces no new database or sheet tab.
The implementation contract keeps application history, package persistence, Gold generation, and external submission out of scope.
No path outside this governance branch's allowed_paths changes.
stop_conditions: Contract design requires fuzzy or third-party-only identity to persist a decision.
Contract design requires changing Match Truth, Candidate Truth, Employer Truth, exact-role identity, qualification semantics, Gold doctrine, application history semantics, or submission policy.
Contract design requires a new database, new sheet tab, UI, scheduled Gmail, browser automation, or automatic submission.
Any runtime/schema/test path changes on this governance-only branch.
review_requirements: This governance candidate must receive independent adversarial review before promotion. Cursor is the normal reviewer when available. Any alternate reviewer requires a fresh Bora exception scoped to the exact frozen candidate; no prior Claude exception carries forward.
human_approval_requirements: Merging/accepting this governance contract does not itself authorize runtime implementation. Bora must separately and explicitly authorize the exact CAREER_OS_PURSUIT_DECISION_PERSISTENCE_V1 implementation contract after review and canonical recovery.
